title: SQL Server option gives errors using same setup as original mRemoteNG 1.76
author: vansanper
body_snippet:
After upgrading to mRemoteNG 1.82 from original 1.76 (first install) when setting up the SQL Server option setting the same data:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Two separate things here, and you found a real bug in the first one.

**The `{0}` / `{1}` message is our fault.** The options page was rendering `Language.RdpErrorUnknown` for a failed SQL test — that's an *RDP protocol* string ("An unknown error has occurred on {0} (Error {1})"), and nothing ever formatted it, so you saw the placeholders verbatim.
